descriptionChirho: Gerar, a Philistine city in the Negev region associated with Abraham and Isaac narratives (Gen 20, 26); attested with various prepositions (in-Gerar, from-Gerar, to-Gerar) and standalone. English 'Gerar/in Gerar', Spanish 'Gerar/en Gerar', Hindi गरार/गेरर, Arabic جَرارَ/مِن جَرارَ, Korean 그랄, Swahili 'Gerari/kutoka Gerari'. All prepositional variants denote the same geographic location.
